title: RunHam Custom Metrics
description: A JSON file that RunHam shows as a dashboard card and, optionally, in the Metrics Bar.

symbol.description: SF Symbols name shown next to the title. Defaults to chart.bar.horizontal.page.fill.

metricsBarValue.description: Short text shown in the Metrics Bar when this source is turned on there.

metrics.description: Rows of the card, from top to bottom.

formattedValue.description: Value text exactly as it should appear.

normalizedValue.description: Optional 0–1 value. When present, a progress bar is drawn under the row. Values outside 0–1 are clamped.

lastUpdatedDate.description: ISO 8601 date and time with a time zone, with or without fractional seconds.
